evidence.P1: Crew's War chain ev-020->ev-023->ev-024->ev-025 is causally tight, but Neo and Trinity ev-004->ev-016 and ev-034->ev-044 are thematic and-then without same-plot enablement and Neo's Awakening ev-032->ev-039 jumps without intermediate conditioning
evidence.P2: Each plot holds one stance — Neo's Awakening Identity, Crew's War Self-preservation vs sacrifice, Morpheus Faith vs proof, Neo and Trinity Doubt vs love, Matrix Truth vs lie — shared events like ev-025 are reframed per dilemma not retold
evidence.P3: Crew's War omits ev-029 Cypher's murders of Apoc/Switch/Dozer that directly enacts its self-preservation pole and Morpheus plot omits ev-013 Desert reveal, while ev-025 appears in three plots with thin justification for Neo's Awakening
evidence.P4: Neo's Awakening ev-004 to ev-045 and Neo and Trinity ev-004 to ev-047 complete setup-turn-resolution, but Crew's War ends at ev-042 Sentinel ambush without ev-046 Escape resolution and Matrix ends at ev-043 flight without ev-045 awakening payoff leaving arcs dangling
evidence.P5: Five throughlines stay distinct — Identity, Objective sacrifice, Faith, Love, Society — overlapping events ev-010 ev-025 ev-045 are reinterpreted per theme (e.g., ev-025 as identity assignment vs objective sacrifice vs faith enactment) rather than rehashed

raw.commentary: Layer shows strong perspective discipline and non-redundancy across five throughlines, but causal integrity is uneven due to relationship-plot and-then links, membership omits key enactments like ev-029, and two objective/society arcs dangle before resolution.
